meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 收到“执行计划”类请求时，Claude 不会自己动手，而是担任协调者：把各个阶段分派给子代理完成，并在每阶段后安排验证与复查，全部通过才提交；未收到完成报告不进下一阶段，阶段间还会同步分支。
howto.when: 当你说要“执行”“运行”或“实施”某个计划时，尤其当计划由 make-plan 生成。

say.text: 执行这个 make-plan 生成的计划。
say.note: Claude 会部署多个子代理分别执行和验证。

say.text: 按计划开始实施，验证通过后再提交。
say.note: 只有检查通过，提交才会发生。

say.text: 执行计划第二阶段的实现。
say.note: 该阶段会派执行子代理并做阶段后检查。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it coordinates, not executes. It deploys subagents to implement each phase, then verify, grep anti-patterns, and review quality; commits only after verification, and syncs branches between phases.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute this plan generated by make-plan.
say_en.note: Claude deploys subagents to run and verify it.

say_en.text: Start implementing the plan and commit after verification.
say_en.note: It commits only after all checks pass.

say_en.text: Implement phase two of the plan.
say_en.note: Deploys an implementation subagent, then checks that phase.
